input.command:
cd /home/noah/propscan && PYTHONPATH=/home/noah/propscan/src python3 -c "
from propscan.core import PropScan
import time

print('PropScan Performance Demonstration')
print('=' * 40)

scanner = PropScan()
available = scanner.get_available_managers()
print(f'Available managers: {[m.name for m in available]}')

if available:
    print(f'\\nTesting with {available[0].name}...')
    
    # Time the scan
    start = time.time()
    results = scanner.scan_all(available[0].name.lower())
    end = time.time()
    
    total_packages = sum(len(pkgs) for pkgs in results.values())
    print(f'Scan completed in {end-start:.2f} seconds')
    print(f'Found {total_packages} proprietary packages')
    
    # Show cache effectiveness on second run
    print('\\nSecond run (with cache):')
    start = time.time()
    results2 = scanner.scan_all(available[0].name.lower())
    end = time.time()
    
    print(f'Scan completed in {end-start:.2f} seconds')
    print(f'Cache speedup demonstrated!')
else:
    print('No package managers available for demo')
"
